steps.title: Vehicles tab — filter chips
steps.notes:
Chip label prefixes only — counts validated against the API in step 3. Verified live 3 Aug 2026 that the chip row contains exactly three clickable chips and no filter icon/Offline option. settleMs covers the fleet list load. Selector is the exact XML-encoded content-desc "Vehicles
Tab 2 of 4" because the bare string "Vehicles" is ambiguous and resolved to the wrong element (Loads tab) in a raw substring match.

steps.title: Read the fleet counts from the backend
steps.notes: No UI interaction. Binds api.running / api.stoppage / api.noInfo. A non-2xx status fails the step, which is why assertions is empty — the status check IS the assertion. See api/contracts/getAllFilterCount.md.

steps.title: Chip counts match the backend
steps.notes: No IF guard: verified live 3 Aug 2026 that the Running chip renders 'Running (0)' when nothing is running, so an API-sourced expectation is correct at zero too — this assertion now runs unconditionally instead of being skipped. api.noInfo / the All chip are deliberately not asserted here — the app exposes no No-Info chip, and the All chip is not the sum of running+stoppage+noInfo (verified live: 0+2+79=81 vs All=92).
